rules.R1a-r5: services._build pass 3, the R1a-r3 guard with one disjunct added (the patch, verbatim): where more than one procedure family is read performed - pass 1's performed_families, the office visit not counted (several_performed) - an act a lesion label or specimen binds, whose own clause names no site (not own_anat), whose part names no service (not act_part_family), whose kind is not catalogue.NOT_REPORTED (clip, cannulation) and whose clause does not deny or cancel it, is unbound as R1a-r3 unbinds it, whatever was or was not told since the lesion's passage; and under the same conditions it takes no site from another clause of its sentence (anat and region cleared: _family_for_act places it by nothing it does not say itself, or leaves it unplaced, and the code it alone supports is held). A denial keeps its label (as R1a-r3); a clip or a cannulation keeps its label (it never needs a code of its own: Mara's 'One prophylactic clip was placed at the COL-2 resection site.'). An act R1a-r3 unbinds under the same conditions takes no other clause's site either (the 'R8 R5 G1 ... the gastroscope named' row). No telling is detected and no word is listed; nothing else in the reader changes.
